findings.evidence: `Basic.lean:111-112` defines `realOperator (t : ℝ) := S t.toNNReal`; Mathlib has `continuous_real_toNNReal` (`Mathlib/Topology/Instances/NNReal/Lemmas.lean:58`), and `Basic.lean:105-107` gives the orbit tendsto at `0` for nonnegative time.
findings.fix: Prove `StronglyContinuousSemigroup.continuous_realOperator_orbit (S) (x) : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => S.realOperator t x)` first, using the existing positive-time argument, `continuous_real_toNNReal` at zero, and local constancy for `t < 0`; derive the half-line wrapper from it if still useful.
findings.issue: `continuousOn_realOperator_orbit` only states continuity on `Set.Ici 0`, but `realOperator` is defined on all `ℝ` by `S t.toNNReal`, so the orbit is continuous on all real times.

findings.evidence: At `0`, `(S.continuousAt_zero_tendsto x).comp continuous_real_toNNReal.continuousAt.tendsto` gives continuity of `u ↦ S.realOperator u x`; for `t < 0`, `Real.toNNReal` is locally constant at `0`.
findings.fix: Replace it with an assumption-free theorem `ContinuousAt (fun u : ℝ => S.realOperator u x) t`, or derive it directly from the global `Continuous` theorem.
findings.issue: `continuousAt_realOperator_orbit` requires `0 < t`, but the same `realOperator` shim is continuous at `t = 0` and at negative `t` as well.

findings.evidence: The current proof only uses `ha`/`hb` to embed `Set.uIcc a b` into `Set.Ici 0`; that restriction disappears from the stronger all-real continuity theorem.
findings.fix: State `ContinuousOn (fun t : ℝ => S.realOperator t x) (Set.uIcc a b)` with no endpoint hypotheses, derived from the global orbit continuity.
findings.issue: `continuousOn_realOperator_orbit_uIcc` carries unnecessary endpoint assumptions `0 ≤ a` and `0 ≤ b` once the real-time shim is used.

summary: The new orbit-continuity API is under-generalized for the public `realOperator` shim: since negative times are defined via `t.toNNReal`, the orbit is continuous on all real times, not only on the nonnegative half-line or positive points.
